verdict.rationale: Poke is itself an AI agent/assistant product; the evidence (poke-docs-3, poke-docs-4, poke-docs-6) shows it acting as an MCP *client* that connects to user-created MCP servers, not as an MCP server that other agents connect to. Per the agent-role exception, serving an official MCP server is a different axis and no such server-mode is evidenced here.
